moon.means: the moon in the sky and its light: 1 — a clear moonlit night, 0 — stolen: the sky goes black, only the windows glow

moon_x.means: where the moon is on the screen, a share of the 16:9 scene's width (its crescent; the light and the shadows — from the moon at its place in the sky, lights.moon)

moon_y.means: where the moon is on the screen, a share of the height from the top

stars.means: the stars: 1 — all, toward 0 the faint ones go out first

blizzard.means: the blizzard: the distance drowns in a snowy haze, snow flies, the wind tears the smoke

dawn.means: the dawn: the sky turns pink over the steppe on the right, the stars go out, the moon pales

morning.means: Christmas morning: a low sun on the right, shadows from it, the windows go dark

beat.means: the film's beat (the module film): film — the scene's whole cut; a beat's name — that beat from the start

sack.means: a sack on the snow by Tchub's fence: 0 — none, 1 — lying there (someone in it)

sack_a.means: where the sack is, metres across (it is dragged)

sack_d.means: where the sack is, metres in depth
